STUDIEVEREISTEN
Geen specifieke studievereisten
.

As an AI Automation Engineer, you will design, build and maintain a portfolio of automation solutions that support mozzeno's teams and business processes ¿ increasingly powered by AI.

Concretely, you will:

• Build automations with Python and PowerShell ¿ scripts, integrations and services that connect our applications, move and transform data, and remove manual steps across the organisation.
• Design and ship AI-powered workflows using Dify ¿ our AI workflow platform ¿ to orchestrate LLM-based steps (document processing, classification, extraction, drafting, internal assistants and agents) and embed them safely into our business processes.
• Orchestrate end-to-end processes across our tools and systems ¿ understanding how each application delivers part of the overall solution, and building the integrations and logic that make them work together reliably from one end to the other.
• Develop functional expertise in our solution architecture, digging into the operational reality of each process to identify pain points and formulate solutions that genuinely improve the way we work.
• Manage and get the most out of the external tools used by our teams, keeping them current, well-integrated and delivering real value. 
• You have a degree in computer science, or you are self-taught with tangible IT experience.
• You are proficient in Python and PowerShell for automation, scripting and integration work ¿ comfortable working with APIs, manipulating data, and building reliable, maintainable code.
• You have a genuine interest in AI and LLMs, and ideally hands-on experience building workflows with Dify (or similar tools such as n8n, LangChain, Make, or comparable LLM-orchestration platforms). You are familiar with concepts such as prompting, RAG, embeddings, agentic workflows and tool/function calling, and understand how to put an LLM to work reliably inside a business process.
• You are comfortable integrating and orchestrating systems through APIs, and think naturally about how tools and processes fit together end to end.
• You are at ease in a cloud environment (Google, AWS).
• You are naturally eager to learn the big picture, to dive into the functional and operational aspects of a business process, to understand the details and pain points, and to formulate solutions to improve them.
• You have excellent problem-solving skills and can judge when to involve peers or experts.
• You are detail-oriented, with strong organisational skills and the ability to manage several tasks and projects at once.
• You have excellent communication and collaboration skills, and the ability to work with a range of stakeholders across the organisation.
• You can work effectively in French & English, and Dutch is always an asset 
• A unique professional positioning, obviously technology-focused, but truly cross-functional and business-oriented.
• An extremely pleasant working environment, based outside Brussels so you can avoid unnecessary traffic jams.
• Joining a team full of talented, motivated and passionate professionals. We are a human-sized company where team spirit and collaboration are the standard.
• Being involved in a fast-growing company offering real development opportunities.
• A company culture that values initiative, taking responsibility and commitment.
• An exciting and stimulating role in a fast-growing fintech.
• A competitive salary and benefits package.

• Team leadership & coaching - Provide mentorship and day-to-day support to developers and data scientists, fostering a culture of continuous learning. Help senior engineers grow junior colleagues and keep knowledge flowing across the team.
• Technical project leadership - Lead the delivery of technical projects end to end - infrastructure, platform, security, tooling and cross-cutting engineering initiatives - from scoping through rollout. Business-driven projects are owned by Product Owners; you partner closely with them while taking the lead on the technical roadmap and its execution.
• Recruitment & onboarding - Lead hiring for developers, infrastructure engineers, and data & AI specialists. Design and oversee onboarding that integrates new hires quickly and effectively into the team and its practices.
• Process refinement - Work with Product Owners to shape and fine-tune agile practices (backlog management, sprint planning, retrospectives) that maximise productivity and keep focus on strategic priorities. Continuously trial new techniques - such as AI-assisted coding and process automation - to raise efficiency and quality.
• Visibility & communication - Ensure transparent reporting of achievements, roadmaps and risks to stakeholders. Run regular updates on progress, risks and resource needs, and build a shared understanding of priorities across engineering, product and business.
• Collaboration & facilitation - Act as the bridge between developers, Product Owners, data scientists and external partners. Facilitate discussions on requirements and dependencies so projects run smoothly and teams stay aligned.
• Technical oversight - Bring deep, hands-on experience with our stack or equivalent (AWS, .NET, Angular, Python, event-driven micro-services), enough real depth to debug a production issue or challenge an architectural decision yourself, not just follow the conversation. Champion security best practices and infrastructure improvements, while delegating implementation to subject-matter experts.
• Culture & growth - Foster an environment where engineers feel accountable and empowered to take ownership. Encourage curiosity and a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset, and promote AI and emerging tools that streamline work and sharpen the team's skills. 
• Several years of hands-on experience as a Software Engineer, Architect, or DevOps/Platform Engineer, ideally followed by a move into a people-management or tech-lead role. 
• Experience managing engineering or cross-functional teams, with a track record of coaching people and growing their skills.
• A record of leading technical projects or initiatives through to delivery.
• Proven ability to design and refine agile or lean processes that improve delivery effectiveness.
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills; comfortable presenting plans, progress and blockers to technical and non-technical audiences alike.
• Organised and detail-oriented, able to juggle multiple initiatives without losing sight of the big picture.
• Comfortable introducing new tools and techniques (e.g., AI-assisted development) and measuring their impact.
• Enough technical literacy in cloud infrastructure, web technologies and DevOps pipelines to understand team challenges and shape high-level decisions.
• Fluency in French or Dutch alongside professional English.
Nice to have

• Prior experience in fintech or other regulated environments.
• Experience working with near-shore or hybrid teams. 
• Opportunity to be part of a great and extremely motivating start-up adventure.
• A pleasant working environment, conveniently located outside Brussels and easily accessible by car, avoiding the usual traffic.
• A company culture valuing empowerment and bringing career development perspectives.
• Competitive salary package related to your profile and experience.
